manifest.conversion: Avro to Parquet; all fields and rows retained; record_index added

quality-checks.crc_caution: SBS-3 zero-parity records are unverified under transmitted-message CRC, not demonstrated corrupt; other DFs have different parity semantics

reconstruction.policy: Most recent preceding opposite parity per ICAO in (server time, record index) order; <=10s; DF17 TC9-18; no fallback after zone mismatch

manifest.sampling: First 16 MiB compressed bytes only; neither random nor complete-hour coverage

quality-checks.crc_caution: SBS-3 zero-parity records are unverified under transmitted-message CRC, not demonstrated corrupt; other DFs have different parity semantics

reconstruction.policy: Most recent preceding opposite parity per ICAO in (server time, record index) order; <=10s; DF17 TC9-18; no fallback after zone mismatch

streaming.semantics: All same-aircraft opposite-parity pairs within +/-10s that pyModeS accepts; not latest-only selection or transmission deduplication
streaming.faults: Delivery order and duplicate copies are injected; messages, IDs and source times remain real
streaming.limits: File source, Parquet sink, local[2]; graceful restart only; no Kafka, MongoDB, crash injection, field fusion, or canonical state publication

scenarios.name: checkpoint_restart
scenarios.restart: graceful stop/restart using the same checkpoint

measurement_limits: Single local runs, some concurrent; task metrics are not process RSS or a scaling comparison. Native Spark stateful join probe, not complete aircraft-state reconstruction.
